title: predict.approved.v1
description: Phase 6 — proofreader-aggregator output. Emitted exactly once per `prediction_id` when the proofreader quorum (default ⌊N/2⌋+1, N=len(swarm.agents.proofreader.replicas.PROOFREADER_POLICY_CLASSES)) accepts a `predict.final`. The `cache.v1` agent and any user-facing publisher subscribe HERE — never to `predict.final` directly — so a candidate prediction can never reach the API surface without proofreader approval (ROADMAP §736 contract). Carries the full predict.final payload verbatim under `final` so downstream consumers do not need a join. Mirrors `ai/swarm/agents/payloads.py::PredictApproved`.

schema_version.description: Payload schema marker. 1 = legacy payload without qa_correlation_id. 2 = additive shape with qa_correlation_id (Phase 10 §10.19). 3 = additive citation_signature and optional calibration_state_horizon fields. When absent, consumers must treat the payload as version 1 for backward compatibility.

prediction_id.description: Deterministic id of the predict.final being approved.

qa_correlation_id.description: Optional QA fanout correlation id (Phase 10 §10.19); round-trips from qa.request.v1 through predict.request → predict.final → here. Present when this prediction originated from an NLP QA dispatch.

approved_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of the aggregator's quorum-met decision.

approved_by.description: Proofreader agent ids (e.g. `proof.sanity.v1`) whose `accept` verdict satisfied quorum.

verdict_count.description: Total proofreader verdicts received in the aggregation window.

final.description: The full predict.final payload, verbatim. Schema = predict.final.

calibration_version.description: Echo of final.calibration_version for join-free audit replay.

calibration_state_horizon.description: Phase 10 §10.27 additive calibration horizon marker for the predicted fixture state at answer-render time.

citation_signature.description: Phase 10 §10.21.8 additive integrity signature: HMAC-SHA256 over (prediction_id || produced_at_utc || model_versions_canonical || calibration_version).

citation_key_id.description: Phase 10 §10.21.8 additive signing key id for citation_signature (sha256(key_bytes)[:16]).
